label: The legality test for raising a literal
section: The legality test for raising a literal
subgoals: Form the cube obtained by raising one literal
Check whether the new minterms meet the OFF-set
Accept the raise only when no OFF minterm is added

label: Greedy expansion to a prime
subgoals: Visit the literals in a fixed order
Keep every raise that stays off the OFF-set
Stop when no remaining literal can be raised, giving a prime

label: Steering expansion to shrink the cover
section: Steering expansion to shrink the cover
subgoals: Prefer raises that make the cube absorb other cubes of the cover
Delete every cube contained in an expanded cube
Process the cubes from the smallest to the largest
